text:
mira (product): Idea: a 'burst slider' in Console to request short windows of extra reserved throughput. Self-serve, TTLed, with explicit billing consent. Need engineering constraints and rollout plan.
kevin (eng): Must integrate with policy-evaluator. Enforce by RPS+token-rate. API model simple: amount, duration_mins, billing_mode.
sasha (eng-sre): Safety: region budget cap (default 10%), per-tenant cooldown (default 1h), global kill-switch. Alerts if region_temp_use > 75% of region cap.
noor (finance): If billing_mode=charge_now, require acceptance checkbox + provisional hold. Exportable line items required.
evan (solutions): CS wants audit log entries + revoke button and email confirmation to customer.
ops-bot: Note: migration for burst_requests table scheduled after canary.
mira (product): Rollout: feature-flagged internal -> 3 pilot tenants -> region cap tuning -> GA. Metrics: requests, approves, reverts, region_pct. Owners: kevin API/policy, sasha canary/alerts, noor billing, evan docs. Meeting to open spec PR tomorrow. :thumbsup:
